summary: The bad() method reads untrusted data from a TCP socket, splits it on '-', and concatenates each piece directly into a JDBC batch UPDATE string executed via Statement.addBatch/executeBatch, enabling SQL injection. The fix switches to a PreparedStatement with a parameterized query ('... where name=?') and binds each name via setString before addBatch, so the per-name UPDATE feature and batch semantics are preserved while input is treated strictly as data.
